finding: Row 3's assertion is 'the derivation's signature takes the spec's text, not a path, so no test of it can reach a file in this repository' and its mutant is 'give it a path parameter'. In Go both are `func(string)`: `func Floor(text string) []Unit` and `func Floor(path string) []Unit` are the same type, so no input, no compile-time assertion and no `reflect.TypeOf` comparison separates the shipped code from the mutant — the row fails §11's own rule 1. It also fails rule 2: the assertion names a property of a declaration and a universal negative over all possible tests ('no test of it can reach a file'), and no input at all. This is the row the round-3 repair produced by deleting the 'contains no total' clause, so the class survived the repair in a new form.
suggestion: Make it an input rather than a signature. 'Called with a two-paragraph literal string whose text contains the characters `spec/0.1.0.md`, the derivation returns the units of that string' — under the path mutant that call reads a file, or fails, and returns something else. Strengthen it by running the same call with the process working directory set to an empty temp dir, which the text form passes and no path form can.
